rationale: Y lands the PR's most severe ground-truth finding almost exactly (hsliuustc0106's High: v2 config shares model_type with legacy v1, so a legacy checkpoint silently parses as v2 and now hard-fails strict weight loading), plus partial matches on the stream-slot-leak region, the WER-PCM-fallback note, NPU dummy-run gap, and stale-docstring concern. X hits the WER-PCM-fallback and NPU-gap findings too but only glances off the v2-collision issue via a differently-framed 'broad except' critique, and misses the docstring staleness and slot-leak code region entirely.
